title: Write 5 objection-handling email scripts for bootcamp directors hesitating on flat pricing
description:
Write 5 concise, persuasive objection-handling email scripts (100-150 words each) for sales and community leads speaking with Nigerian bootcamp founders.

Objections to resolve:
1. 'Why flat pricing instead of paying only for active students?' (Contrast predictability vs punitive growth penalties).
2. 'Can our learners access live classes easily on mobile data?' (Spotlight lightweight audio Buzz and low-bandwidth optimizations).
3. 'Will AI replace instructor feedback or confuse learners?' (Clarify how AI acts as an assistant to instructors, not a replacement).
4. 'How hard is it to move existing cohorts from WhatsApp or Telegram?' (Highlight simple migration and private channel setup).
5. 'Is 3 cohorts enough to start on Starter?' (Explain free Starter capabilities and seamless upgrade to Pro).

Deliver ready-to-use email copy in the attachment, citing verified zedu.chat features.
rationale: Addresses critical conversion hurdles for Nigerian bootcamp operators evaluating Zedu, directly supporting bootcamp acquisition and Starter-to-Pro conversion.
